messages.subject: broken opts page on wiki
parts:
The page that describes all the opts() on the ggplot2 wiki:

https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/+opts%28%29-List

is broken in some way. Nothing is displayed after the "Axis Attributes"
heading, despite the page having not been edited in 10 months. Going to
edit the page shows that the full text is still there. Any idea why it
is no longer displaying properly?

--
Brian S. Diggs, PhD
Senior Research Associate, Department of Surgery
Oregon Health & Science University

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: broken opts page on wiki
parts:
I also noticed it was broken a few days ago, but it's working for me now.

I think Github makes frequent changes to their wiki page generation system because the syntax coloring changes from time to time, so maybe that has something to do with it. 

Also, it looks like that page is written with Creole. Markdown is more commonly used (and better supported), so might be a good idea to convert it to Markdown.

-Winston
